title: DashboardLayoutTemplate
description: Assembles any number of widgets, each a self-contained chart/table/stat_card matching one of the sibling *_chart.schema.json / table.schema.json / stat_card.schema.json shapes, into one page. The renderer dispatches purely on each widget's data.type -- it never inspects field names beyond that, so any producer (ai_layer, a subagent, a hand-written example) that emits a conformant widget can be dropped in unchanged.

size.description: Grid hint only -- not part of the widget's own schema. quarter widgets (normally stat_card) pack four to a row; half widgets pack two; full spans the page. The layout packer flushes whatever doesn't fill a row rather than leaving a gap.

data.description: One widget, required to satisfy its own schema file: stat_card.schema.json, gauge_chart.schema.json, pie_chart.schema.json, bar_chart.schema.json, line_chart.schema.json, area_chart.schema.json, stacked_bar_chart.schema.json, or table.schema.json. Its own `type` field (e.g. "bar", "gauge", "stat_card") is what the renderer switches on.
